name: Standing iron candelabra
description: A floor candelabra of dark wrought iron about 1.7 m tall: three splayed legs with curled toes, a twisted square stem with a knop, and four arms in a cross bending up to drip pans round a taller centre candle, five ivory candles in all.

provenance.prompt: A floor candelabra of wrought iron with five candles, about 0.5 × 0.5 × 1.7 m.
